sources: Generated service catalog and room relationships
activated_behavior: single active service request per NPC instance
merchant and trainer execution only after admission
safe_fallback: Reject missing, dead, wrong-room, unsupported, or concurrently active service requests before character, inventory, stock, or trainer state mutation.
runtime_impact: Merchant and trainer commands now have explicit NPC-instance ownership.
character_save_impact: Existing service transactions remain authoritative; rejected admission performs no character mutation.
world_state_impact: Compact service ownership and completion metadata is persisted with the NPC instance.
